in_hebrew.name: Etem
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Etem הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew word ‘et’, meaning ‘God’. It can also represent ‘eternity’, as in the eternal presence of God. In the Bible, the name Etem appears in the Old Testament, specifically in the Book of Isaiah.

in_greek.name: Etem
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God; Eternity
in_greek.long_meaning: Etem είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Hebrew word ‘et’, meaning ‘God’. It can also represent ‘eternity’, as in the eternal presence of God. In the Bible, the name Etem appears in the Old Testament, specifically in the Book of Isaiah.

in_latin.name: Etem
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God; Eternity
in_latin.long_meaning: Etem est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Hebrew word ‘et’, meaning ‘God’. It can also represent ‘eternity’, as in the eternal presence of God. In the Bible, the name Etem appears in the Old Testament, specifically in the Book of Isaiah.
